description: Marketable Natural Gas Production by Grouping Energy Futures 2017 Supplement is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Canada Energy Regulator | La Régie de l’énergie du Canada. The Energy Future annual report provides historical and projected monthly marketable natural gas production by gas grouping from the beginning of 2000 to the end of 2018 for each report case. The report presents distinct cases, each of which are based on a set of assumptions, which are described in detail at:. Coverage: Canada.
